source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: The Thyroid Gland

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 17.4 L40-L45 identifies thyroxine/T4 formation in thyroid follicles, and L49 explicitly says thyroid secretes T3/T4. Thus thyroid alone is the requested thyroxine-producing gland; pituitary regulation is not thyroxine manufacture. Other options are real endocrine glands with pancreatic and adrenal functions grounded at17.9 L29-L33 and17.3 L79,L97. All four are plausible same-category labels, no unique typography or grammar cue.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Two sentences explicitly name thyroid as producing thyroid hormones including thyroxine, supported17.4 L44-L45,L49. The second sentence accurately states metabolism effect atL55-L56,L82. No therapeutic or changing clinical claim is introduced.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Тиреоидные гормоны повышают основной обмен и теплопродукцию организма.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 17.4 L55 calls T3/T4 metabolic hormones influencing basal metabolic rate and describes enhanced nutrient breakdown/oxygen use;L56 describes the calorigenic heat effect. In this conventional T3/T4 context тиреоидные гормоны denotes these metabolic thyroid hormones, not an assertion that calcitonin has identical action. This own-thyroid functional fact goes beyond where thyroxine is made.

absoluteLevel.ground: Matching the named hormone thyroxine with its gland is familiar to readers interested in school biology/endocrine health, but need not be known by general adults outside that theme. All four are real endocrine glands, so absent thematic knowledge the row does not collapse to one answer. No rare mechanistic or professional detail makes it HARD.
